title: Trust Assertion Message (TAM)
description: JSON Schema for the ZTXP Trust Assertion Message format (draft-ztxp-02, §10.1). All REQUIRED fields must be present; unknown top-level fields are permitted and MUST NOT cause rejection.

version.description: ZTXP protocol version string (e.g. '0.2'). Unknown values SHOULD cause rejection.

issuer.description: URI identifying the issuing trust domain or broker (e.g. 'ztxp://broker.example.com').

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which this TAM was issued.

subject.description: The principal (user or service account) for whom the TAM is issued.

device.description: The device from which the request originates.

posture.description: OPTIONAL. Device compliance and attestation information.

compliant.description: Whether the device satisfies the governing compliance policy. A value of false SHOULD result in deny unless policy explicitly allows non-compliant devices.

attestation.description: OPTIONAL. Attestation scheme (e.g. 'TPM2', 'MDM'). Treated as unverified evidence unless independently verified.

context.description: Environmental and session context for this request.

risk_score.description: Risk score in [0, 100]. 0 = lowest risk, 100 = highest risk. Values outside this range MUST cause TAM rejection.

trust_level.description: OPTIONAL. Normalized trust classification. Implementations MUST map this to policy-relevant thresholds.

id.description: URI or identifier of the target resource (e.g. 'app://internal-finance').

action.description: The requested action on the resource (e.g. 'read', 'write').

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the canonical form of this TAM (see §4.1). The signature object itself is excluded from the signed input.

alg.description: Signing algorithm (e.g. 'Ed25519', 'EdDSA', 'ES256'). Implementations MUST support Ed25519.

key_id.description: URI identifying the public key used for this signature.

evidence.description: OPTIONAL. Arbitrary evidence claims about the subject, device, or environment. Implementations MUST NOT treat these as verified without an independent verification path.

chain.description: OPTIONAL. Ordered list of prior TAM assertions from upstream trust domains, preserving chain of custody (see §10.5). Each element is a prior TAM object.
